Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: compact game portrait concept sheet. Input image is STYLE ONLY; do not copy its character identities or costumes. Reproduce its VERY SIMPLE flat paper-cut/vector-like storybook art: smooth rounded silhouettes, broad clean flat colour shapes, essentially no outlines, only one simple shadow shape, no painting texture, no gradients, no detailed anatomy or anime rendering. The KEY eye design is simple dark round/oval pupils, EACH WITH ONE CRISP BRIGHT WHITE CATCHLIGHT clearly INSIDE it at upper-left. Keep each catchlight bold enough to survive a small 40px portrait; never omit it, never replace it with white eyelids. Where iris colour is specified, use only a thin coloured rim around the large dark pupil, preserving both white glints. Both eyes open and readable, including behind glasses. Preserve adult ages: young adults look adult, older adults have a few simple age lines. Plain warm ivory backdrop. No text, labels, borders, badges with writing, scenery, hand-held props, animals, hands, arms, legs, magic effects or action poses. Portraits from head to upper chest, front-facing, full hair/hat and shoulders visible, generous clear space between subjects, identical head scale. Readable distinct hair/head silhouettes, face shapes and collars before costume detail.
Make ONE horizontal row of exactly 5 separate portrait busts, in this exact left-to-right order:
1. Lyra Vaneshade (19, she/her): Pale, long straight crimson hair, a narrow face and sharply arched brows; a neat crimson shoulder cape over academy navy. Proud, exacting noble pyromancer.
2. Tobias Fennick (19, he/him): Pale, short ginger crop, a broad square face and very broad shoulders; a worn green collar over plain academy clothes. Gentle farm boy with an open, slightly sheepish smile.
3. Seraphine Hale (19, she/her): Pale, slight face; loose ivory hair framing the cheeks, silver-grey irises around dark highlighted pupils, and a dark blue scarf with a few large stars. Dreamy, perceptive seer.
4. Corvin Ashby (19, he/him): Warm tan, dark brown hair swept into a small high knot, a lean angular face and crooked grin; an open navy collar and charcoal scarf. Charming, reckless passage-finder.
5. Mir Ten (19, they/them): Copper-brown skin, wild brick-red hair, brass goggles pushed above the forehead, a round face and an eager grin; teal apron straps over academy navy, one soot smudge. Curious clockworks inventor.
Final constraint: do not turn round pupils into thin anime eye slits; both pupil highlights must be visibly white on every face. No extra figures.
